purpose: Evaluate minimal evidence-gap prioritization against claim auditing, literature search, citation checks, source-data audits, and analysis execution.

cases.query: 根据现有 Figure 1–4 和 claims，找出投稿前 P0/P1 缺口与最小补分析。
cases.rationale: Prioritizing gaps in an existing evidence package is the core task.

cases.query: 把审稿意见整理成 1–3 个最小 work packages，写清成本、依赖和验收标准。
cases.rationale: Reviewer-driven minimal-fix planning belongs here.

cases.query: 这套结果不足以支持机制 claim，比较补 control、降级写法和删除 claim 三条路径。
cases.rationale: Alternative gap-closing paths are a core output.

cases.query: 从 claim-evidence map 中识别缺数据、缺统计、缺外部验证和复现缺口。
cases.rationale: Typed gap extraction from an existing map belongs here.

cases.query: 先汇总草稿括号批注为 revision backlog，不要直接改正文。
cases.rationale: Revision-backlog extraction is an explicit supported mode.

cases.query: 在两周和现有数据限制下，哪些补强会真正改变 claim strength？
cases.rationale: Decision-value prioritization under constraints belongs here.

cases.query: 给每个 reviewer risk 绑定最小 fix、stop condition 和无法关闭的 limitation。
cases.rationale: Risk-bound work packages and stop conditions are core.

cases.query: 比较 rerun existing script、补 sensitivity analysis 和新增 dataset 的成本与收益。
cases.rationale: Cost-benefit triage of gap-closing options belongs here.

cases.query: 删掉不会改变结论的 nice-to-have 分析，只保留 blocking evidence。
cases.rationale: Preventing unbounded analysis is a central principle.

cases.query: 为 exploratory result 设计补证据或安全降级到 Discussion 的验收路径。
cases.rationale: Evidence addition versus wording downgrade is a core gap decision.

cases.query: 逐句判断 Results 是否 overclaim，并给出安全措辞。
cases.rationale: Sentence-level support auditing is owned by claim-evidence-audit.

cases.query: 系统检索最新文献来补 Introduction。
cases.rationale: Open-ended paper discovery belongs to literature search.

cases.query: 核验这些 DOI 是否真实并支持相邻句子。
cases.rationale: Citation identity and fit belong to citation-verifier.

cases.query: 检查 Figure 2 每个 panel 是否有 source data、脚本和统计定义。
cases.rationale: A bounded source-data traceability audit belongs elsewhere.

cases.query: 执行差异表达、补画火山图并更新结果表。
cases.rationale: Analysis execution is not evidence-gap planning.

cases.query: 只润色 Discussion，让行文更简洁。
cases.rationale: Language polishing without evidence triage is outside scope.

cases.query: 检查摘要、正文和补充表中的样本数是否一致。
cases.rationale: Cross-document consistency belongs to manuscript-consistency-audit.

cases.query: 精读这篇指定论文并解释 Figure 4。
cases.rationale: Specified-paper reading belongs to paper-reader.

cases.query: 查 Open Targets 和 ChEMBL 的 target evidence 与 activity records。
cases.rationale: Database lookup is not gap prioritization.

cases.query: 按审稿人要求立即新增一个 cohort 并重跑全部 pipeline。
cases.rationale: Execution of a chosen analysis belongs to implementation, after the decision is made.
